description: This file implements functions for loading and saving data to backup RAM segments, specifically for handling different backup RAM indices, possibly related to real-time clock and hardware calibration states.

methods.name: uint32_t backupRamLoad(backup_ram_e idx)
methods.description: Loads a uint32_t value from backup RAM based on an index, with special handling for RTC-related data.

methods.name: void backupRamSave(backup_ram_e idx,uint32_t value)
methods.description: Saves a uint32_t value to backup RAM at a position determined by an index, with special handling for RTC-related data.
